purpose: Keep Layer A external project dispatch and Layer B RedCap self-development visibly separate while sharing RedCap governance vocabulary.

layer_a.name: external-project-dispatch
layer_a.must_not_claim: Layer A project FSM is not the Layer B closeout runtime.

layer_b.name: redcap-self-development-runtime
layer_b.owner: Cap main agent with Prism acceptance and closeout receipt
layer_b.must_not_claim: Layer B self-development does not require old Dispatcher outbox state to be healthy.

shared_guardrails: Do not route RedCap self-development blockers through old Layer A state.yaml.
Do not remove Layer A compatibility while acceptance tests still cover external project workflows.
Do not duplicate Layer B rules inside host entry files or Layer A manuals.
